title: Epic photo captures just how hard ex-NYC Mayor Eric Adams partied for his 66th birthday
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Eric Adams took the bike ride of shame.

The Big Apple’s former nightlife mayor spent the night Tuesday partying it up for his 66th birthday — and was then spotted the next morning pedaling a City Bike across town while wearing an exhausted look and the same rumpled shirt he wore to the bash.

Adams put a new spin on the “walk of shame” cliche when he was seen on the Upper East Side in the distinctive button-up, with a red stripe, at 8:03 a.m. — as morning commuters hustled to work in the background.

The ex-party mayor looked tired on tires after spending his birthday night celebrating at Mimi’s Italian restaurant and piano bar on Second Avenue and 52nd Street in Midtown Tuesday, according to photos he posted on X.

Adams is shown at the eatery blowing out cake candles and hanging out with billionaire businessman John Catsimatidis, public relations executive Todd Shapiro and sporting goods CEO Mitch Modell at around 10:30 p.m.

The notorious night owl was then captured in a photo making the low-gear victory lap while wearing  earbuds and the same collared button down shirt and brown dress pants after apparently pulling an all-nighter.

“Hold on a second. Don’t you all party all night on your birthday?” Adams wrote on X in response to The Post’s coverage of his bash.

Adams earned a reputation as the “party mayor” for his frequent late-night outings at high-end clubs and restaurants, sometimes alongside celebrities such as A$AP Rocky, Floyd Mayweather, and Cara Delevingne.
